description: The status and, once completed, the result of a background job started by discover_brands, suggest_brand_names, discover_keywords, discover_prompts or start_auto_clustering. Poll it every few seconds until status is "completed" or "failed"; do not start the job again while it is pending or running. A discover_prompts job usually finishes within 15 minutes and fails with error.code timed_out after about 30 minutes. A failed job carries error.code (timed_out, provider_failed, submission_failed or internal_error) and error.message, which says what to do next.
name: get_job
title: Get a background job
